## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric ritual manual by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) — a more compact / condensed *niànsòng fǎ* counterpart to [KR6j0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0228) (T1030 *Guān zìzài dàbēi chéngjiù yújiā liánhuábù niànsòng fǎmén*). CANWWW alt-title: *Liánhuábù niànsòng fǎ* 蓮華部念誦法. Listed at Nanjio 1429.

**Abstract**

The *Yújiā liánhuábù niànsòng fǎ* is a focused practice-text dedicated to the daily liturgical performance of the Lotus-family yoga. Where T1030 ([KR6j0228](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0228)) provides the doctrinal-ritual framework and the broader contextualisation of the practice, the present T1032 supplies the streamlined daily-recitation procedure suitable for routine liturgical use. This pairing of expanded-ritual-manual with condensed-practice-manual is characteristic of Amoghavajra's compositional method: his Esoteric ritual literature often comes in matched pairs of "full" and "abbreviated" forms.
